instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements / revenue-guarantee code-share agreements with major airline partners.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase/revenue-guarantee agreements. FY ends Sep 30. Fuel largely reimbursed by code-share partners Delta, United, and US Airways (~97% of fuel in revenue-guarantee contracts). Each $0.01/gal change = $0.11M impact on non-reimbursed fuel. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Gallons of fuel consumed: 201,526,868 (fiscal year ended September 30, 2007) from operating statistics table.
